full_details: The three deposition sheets were still on the board, and Field's Holinshed was still shut. On an older leaf the margin still read that York was angry, and the messenger was still only a mark. You wrote York's breath giving out over the seizure, and you did not write the prison or the end. At eleven you had Daniel's third book open, your own copy, and you did not go to Paul's to check it against a better one. The afternoon was the Theatre road there and back, Titus at two, and home by six. At seven Alse came in from the Cheapside conduit with the buckets half full. She had seen a press of apprentices and masterless men in Paul's churchyard at noon, then officers, then running. The shops and Ludgate were what she heard on the way, and you kept that separate from what she saw. Mistress Ansell ruled that nobody in the house goes west of the Stocks again this month, lodger included. The loaf was still a thumb short, and still a penny. At the window you said it wants only one blade drawn.
one_sentence: You worked the mark that still said York, read your own Daniel, and at seven heard the churchyard from Alse's buckets.
title: York's rights, and Alse's half-full buckets
